list.blurb: Every trainer from Generation I to IX: where to find them and the exact team they use, from the first Youngster to the Champion — rematches and DLC included.
list.sources: Generation I–IV teams, moves and locations are read from the <pret>pret</pret> decompilations of each game; Generation V–IX teams come from <bulba>Bulbapedia</bulba>'s location pages, spot-checked against Serebii. Battle facilities with random opponents aren't listed.
